bugs.title: Windows Interactive Desktop Isolation & COM Initialization Error 170
bugs.symptom: Calling uiautomation or EnumWindows from background task threads failed with WinError 170 (The requested resource is in use) or returned empty window lists.
bugs.root_cause: The agent execution environment runs under desktop session 'exebox-...', while the user's interactive desktop is 'WinSta0\Default'. Importing uiautomation before attaching to WinSta0\Default caused COM to bind to the empty exebox desktop.
bugs.remediation: Implemented automatic desktop attachment in friday_core/automation/__init__.py and inspector.py using user32.OpenDesktopW('default', 0, False, 0x01FF) and user32.SetThreadDesktop before importing uiautomation.
bugs.verification: 100% verified across all test suites and live execution runs.

bugs.title: Windows 11 Packaged Notepad Zombie Session & TabState Hang
bugs.symptom: Launching 'notepad.exe' initiated background Notepad.exe processes with MainWindowHandle=0 that hung attempting to restore corrupted tab/window states.
bugs.root_cause: Windows 11 App Execution Alias redirects 'notepad.exe' to Microsoft.WindowsNotepad WinUI 3 App, which when called from background sessions checks cached TabState and WindowState .bin files and enters a headless session restore loop.
bugs.remediation: Mapped Notepad activation in apps.py and launcher.py to 'shell:AppsFolder\Microsoft.WindowsNotepad_8wekyb3d8bbwe!App' and enabled shell: protocol handling in safe_launch().
bugs.verification: Notepad launches cleanly, creates top-level window (Untitled - Notepad), and exposes 50+ controls.

bugs.title: UIA Generic Control GetInvokePattern Method Missing
bugs.symptom: Attempting to invoke Calculator buttons via uiautomation.Control resulted in AttributeError: 'Control' object has no attribute 'GetInvokePattern'.
bugs.root_cause: The uiautomation library exposes GetInvokePattern() on typed controls (e.g. ButtonControl, MenuItemControl) rather than the generic Control base class.
bugs.remediation: Updated action_engine.py to dynamically cast or instantiate specific typed controls (auto.ButtonControl, auto.MenuItemControl) when searching and invoking elements.
bugs.verification: Calculator keypad clicks (7, +, 5, =) successfully invoke via SEMANTIC_UIA_INVOKE.

bugs.title: Launcher Token Matcher Spurious Fallback on Stop Words
bugs.symptom: Requesting to launch 'definitely_fake_app_xyz_12345.exe' matched a random shortcut named 'app' or 'application' in the Start Menu and reported success.
bugs.root_cause: find_and_open_desktop_or_system_item() tokenized queries without filtering stop words ('app', 'exe', 'application'), allowing clean_base 'app' in tokens to match with score 60.
bugs.remediation: Added LAUNCHER_STOP_WORDS filter in launcher.py to eliminate 'app', 'application', 'exe', 'the', 'open', 'launch', 'run', 'start' from candidate scoring.
bugs.verification: Fake applications now immediately return (False, app_clean) and action_engine reports honest FAILED status.

bugs.title: Missing Stable Accessibility Identifiers on Research View Buttons
bugs.symptom: Audit scan for 15 stable accessibility identifiers failed to locate 'research_start_btn' and 'research_stop_btn'.
bugs.root_cause: In friday_ui/views/research_view.py, the buttons were set with objectNames 'start_btn' and 'stop_btn'.
bugs.remediation: Updated objectNames in research_view.py to 'research_start_btn' and 'research_stop_btn'.
bugs.verification: All 15 of 15 required accessibility identifiers verified present and stable.

bugs.title: Subprocess Fallback CREATE_NO_WINDOW Hiding GUI Applications
bugs.symptom: safe_launch() subprocess fallback used CREATE_NO_WINDOW and wShowWindow=0 (SW_HIDE), causing GUI applications to spawn with invisible windows.
bugs.root_cause: Launcher was previously configured for silent console command execution, inadvertently suppressing GUI windows.
bugs.remediation: Configured GUI subprocess launches with STARTUPINFO.lpDesktop = r'WinSta0\Default' and wShowWindow = 1 (SW_SHOWNORMAL).
bugs.verification: Applications launch with visible, interactable top-level windows.
